# The site's dependencies, and the registry it may choose from.
project site
  needs web ^2.1
  needs log >=1.2 <2
  needs db ~0.4

package web 2.1.0
  needs log ^1.0
package web 2.3.1
  needs log ^1.4
  needs http ~0.4
package web 3.0.0       # needs log 2, which the site does not allow
  needs log ^2

package http 0.4.2
  needs log >=1.1
package http 0.5.0

package db 0.4.0
  needs pool ^1.0
package db 0.4.7
  needs pool ^1.2
  needs log ^1.5
package db 0.5.1

package pool 1.0.0
package pool 1.2.9
package pool 1.3.0
  needs log ^1.6

package log 1.2.0
package log 1.5.3
package log 2.0.0
